page.content:
Co-creator of Avatar: The Last Airbender.

How Michael Dante DiMartino connects

  • Topic: Avatar: The Last Airbender — Michael Dante DiMartino co-created Avatar: The Last Airbender.
  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — DiMartino showran the original series.
  • Series: The Legend of Korra — DiMartino co-created The Legend of Korra.

What is Michael Dante DiMartino?

Michael Dante DiMartino co-created Avatar with Bryan Konietzko, writing and showrunning Aang's war story and later The Legend of Korra.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender, Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) and The Legend of Korra.
